kua.101.en: The four directions not listed for your number are the ones to avoid: Mishap, Six Killings, Five Ghosts and Severed Fate. In Singapore and Malaysia an HDB flat or condominium bedroom usually offers only two solid walls, so pick the better of the two available directions rather than the best on paper.
